response.justification: Bogdan has a long, versatile engineering career (roughly 15 years including freelance work) with strong breadth across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency backend systems, plus genuine open-source founding experience with GISCollective. However, this role is a Director-level IC focused on AI strategy: it requires recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products or platforms, deep cloud-platform fluency, and the ability to advise strategic enterprise customers and shape future cloud product direction. The resume shows only recent, peripheral AI exposure (MCP code generators and agent tooling at re:cinq), no ML/AI depth or research background, limited cloud-architecture leadership beyond AWS CDK usage, and titles that top out at Staff/Senior IC rather than principal-level technical strategy. The gap between hands-on product engineering and executive-level AI/cloud strategy influence is too wide for this specific role.
strengths: Broad 15-year multi-domain engineering track record (web, mobile, embedded, high-throughput backends)
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform, showing entrepreneurial initiative and product ownership
Strong community presence: conference talks, workshops, courses, and maintained OSS libraries
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or shipped AI products beyond recent agent tooling
Limited cloud platform strategy or architecture leadership at enterprise scale
No evidence of principal/director-level influence or advising strategic customers and partners

key_factors.factor: Seniority/scope vs. director-level IC strategy role
Breadth of engineering experience and OSS founder background
